New projected actionable must not reuse original same-offer-only flag for accepted/expired/terminal/stale history.
Explicit cursor must bind provider identity/mode, including direct-call Store cache.
Trusted consumer has principal row, no token; reuse exact principal/scope kernel without reading or generating credentials.
Delivery requires complete original candidate event proof and final post-wait check, distinct from intentional suppression of proven own revoked/expired recipient.
